day_shape: 69 items: US-Iran 60-day MoU expires with Washington ruling out extension while Trump confirms IRGC backchannel, CENTCOM says 64 vessels redirected under Hormuz blockade, reported Israeli strikes on Abu al-Duhur airport in Syria, Kushner-Hamas Cairo meeting, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: US-Iran diplomacy after MoU expiry
threads.summary: Iran International reported Washington ruled out extending the 60-day interim deal that lapsed Monday, while Trump told Fox News he has a backchannel with IRGC officials and is in 'no hurry' to strike a deal. Kushner said US-Iran conversations are 'more robust than ever'; a senior Iranian official quoted by Jerusalem Post said Tehran is shifting to a 'fully offensive' policy, and Erdogan urged Trump to continue talks.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade and shipping incidents
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS Mason is enforcing the 'steel wall blockade' against Iran, with 64 commercial vessels redirected, 3 disabled and 2 boarded as of 17 August. IRIB relayed a UKMTO report of a cargo ship struck by an unidentified projectile exiting Hormuz, and Jerusalem Post noted Strait traffic rebounded after a weekend dip; Defa Press claimed an Indonesian-flagged Saudi-linked weapons ship was hit at Bab al-Mandeb.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire strains and Kushner track
threads.summary: The IDF said a Hamas explosive device detonated near the Yellow Line in northern Gaza with return gunfire, prompting Israeli strikes; Kushner, Mladenov and Blair met Netanyahu to advance the next stage of the US Gaza plan, while Kushner separately met Hamas leaders in Cairo. Smotrich called on Israel to take over all of Gaza and build settlements, and Israel and the US agreed handed-over Hamas weapons will be destroyed by the ISF.

threads.label: Reported Israeli strike on Syrian airport
threads.summary: Arab media reported four strikes on the runway of Abu al-Duhur military airport in Idlib/eastern Aleppo countryside overnight, with Al Hadath describing them as 'likely Israeli.' IRIB attributed the raid to 'Zionist regime warplanes' and noted some reports indicating Turkish forces are stationed at the base.

threads.label: Iraqi Kurdistan attack fallout
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi phoned his Iraqi counterpart Fuad Hussein on the attack on PM Barzani's office, which Hussein called a 'dangerous precedent,' according to Defa Press. Araghchi separately warned Iraqi Kurds to be vigilant against a 'false flag,' and parliament speaker Qalibaf will lead a delegation to Baghdad on Wednesday.

threads.label: Khamenei office messaging on martyr commemorations
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published the fortieth-day memorial slogan 'We are committed to you until the dawn of appearance' for the 'Martyr of Iran,' alongside a treemap of six senior armed forces appointments and a message urging trust in officials of the three branches. Foreign Minister Araghchi commemorated 'martyrs of the recent one-and-a-half years of American-Zionist aggression against Iran,' and President Pezeshkian said patience and solidarity are key against external pressures.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressures and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International reported a parliamentary 'infiltration' bill restricting contacts with foreign media and universities is drawing broad objections, and cited more than $80 billion in NIOC debt and sovereign-fund arrears from Trump's maximum pressure. A state TV presenter drew backlash for saying 'southern Iran be sacrificed for southern Lebanon' after US strikes damaged southern provinces, and Iran barred two French embassy employees from returning.

Ahvaz with a high of 48 degrees and Ardabil with a high of 27 degrees Celsius are today's hottest and coolest provincial centres respectively. Additionally, over the next three days in the afternoon and early evening hours, convective cloud development, scattered rain showers with possibility of thunderstorms are expected in the elevated areas of southern Sistan and Baluchestan, Hormozgan and southern Kerman. Until the end of the week in some parts of the north-east, east, centre and southern slopes of the Alborz, strong winds in some areas, dust and haze and air quality degradation are not unexpected.

events.title_en: 'We are committed to you until the dawn of appearance'; the special slogan of the fortieth memorial ceremonies for 'the Martyr of Iran'
events.summary_en: 'We are committed to you until the dawn of appearance'; the special slogan of the fortieth memorial ceremonies for 'the Martyr of Iran'. Coinciding with the fortieth day of the funeral and burial of the pure body of the martyred leader, His Eminence Ayatollah Khamenei, and members of his family, the slogan 'We are committed to you until the dawn of appearance' was chosen as the special slogan for the fortieth commemorative ceremonies for 'the Martyr of Iran' throughout the country. This slogan, given the coincidence of the dates of the fortieth memorial ceremonies with the anniversary of the martyrdom of Imam Hassan al-Askari and the beginning of the Imamate of His Eminence the Hujjah son of al-Hasan al-Mahdi, was considered for a set of special programmes to be held in Tehran, Qom, Mashhad and other parts of the country.
